sources.name: Scientific Opinion No. 15 original-edition dependency follow-up
sources.source_family: GCSA Scientific Opinion No. 15 publication and preserved original (bounded dependency)
sources.scope_note: Only the original first edition independently verified while resolving the already known corrected-edition candidate. Separate from the earlier frozen 53-candidate scope. The official Commission release is the registry entrance; ALLEA and KNAW full-text copies are explicitly non-EU institutional archive supplements recorded as such in canonical sources.
sources.discovery_method: Inspected Commission release of 15 April 2024 and corrected Publications Office catalogue/PDF. Retrieved complete original first-edition copies from ALLEA and KNAW, compared all 102 extracted pages and inspected original/corrected imprints and wording changes. Admitted under the user-approved bounded institutional archive allowance, with hashes and separate official publication evidence.
sources.verification_note: Original dependency and corrected candidate included with one analytical corrected-to-original revises relationship. No original EU-hosted PDF or official correction schedule was recovered in this bounded search. Academy text equality does not establish byte or visual identity. This resolves the identified dependency without asserting source-family or EU-wide completeness or advancing the publication cutoff.
